title: ChatHealthy Build Architecture
description: Facts the build needs about where source is read from. Distinct from deployment_architecture.json, which records what is deployed and where it goes. A build that carries business paths in its own source breaks whenever the business layout moves, which is what a refactor does.

name.description: The application's name, as the build reports it.

source_root.description: Repository-relative directory holding the application's html and src. Vite's root.

dist.description: Repository-relative directory vite writes the bundle to. Derived, gitignored.

serves_at.description: Path under the website's publish root where the built bundle is served, without slashes. 'app' serves at /app/.

entry.description: The module the html loads, relative to source_root.

html.description: The html document at source_root that vite treats as the entry document.
